title: Abductee Carol's missing pregnancy and her hybrid daughter
place_text: Her home and aboard a craft

plain: A woman called Carol is said to have been abducted, to have lost a pregnancy that simply vanished, and to have a part-alien daughter, and she was furious at the people working on UFOs. A guest named Dan Sheehan tells this on Michels's show, passing on what he was told, and says her case was studied by John Mack, a researcher of abduction accounts. If true, it would mean abductions involve human pregnancies.
